items.title: Mark the batch outbound-rules action as paged
items.summary: The TypeSpec change adds `@list` to `ManagedNetworkSettingsPropertiesBasicResources.post` so its existing list-result response is generated as a paged long-running operation.

findings.expected: Microsoft.CognitiveServices.ManagedNetworkSettingsPropertiesBasicResources.post preserves its existing language-neutral generated SDK contract.
findings.rationale: TCGC changes the public method from a non-pageable LRO result to pageable iteration with `value` items and a GET `nextLink`. Existing SDK code that consumes one `OutboundRuleListResult` must change to use the generated paging flow.

findings.expected: Microsoft.CognitiveServices.ManagedNetworkSettingsPropertiesBasicResources.post preserves its existing language-neutral generated SDK contract.
findings.rationale: The public generated response changes from `OutboundRuleListResult` to an array of `OutboundRuleBasicResource`. That changes the method's language-neutral return contract and breaks existing callers compiled or written against the list-result model.

findings.actual: Microsoft.CognitiveServices.ManagedNetworkSettingsPropertiesBasicResources.post changed method kind from lro to lropaging.
findings.expected: Microsoft.CognitiveServices.ManagedNetworkSettingsPropertiesBasicResources.post preserves its existing language-neutral generated SDK contract.
findings.rationale: The public method kind changes from `lro` to `lropaging`, altering the generated invocation and result-consumption pattern even though its parameters and LRO polling metadata remain stable.

compliance.summary: All Semantic intents match applicable fetched guidance.

intentAssessments.expected: To enable pagination, decorate the operation with `@list` and expose page items with `@pageItems`; decorators use the `@` prefix and appear before the declaration they decorate.
intentAssessments.actual: The changed TypeSpec adds `@list` before `ManagedNetworkSettingsPropertiesBasicResources.post`; the bounded intent profile identifies `OutboundRuleListResult.value` and `OutboundRuleListResult.nextLink` as its paging constructs.
intentAssessments.rationale: The changed construct is the documented `@list` operation annotation, placed before the operation whose existing list-result shape supplies page items and a next link. The fetched guidance supports this change and no compliance gap is detected.
